name: url-shortener
description: URL shortener — system design demo (Express + Redis, and a Cloudflare Workers port)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @snip/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:workers: npm run build -w @snip/shared && npm run build -w client && npm run dev -w workers
scripts.deploy:workers: npm run build -w @snip/shared && npm run build -w client && npm run deploy -w workers
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @snip/shared && npm run typecheck -ws
